decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) an abrupt multi-sample N drop near start of first window with correlated E/U behavior, possibly indicating a platform or unresolved opposing return; (2) a pronounced coherent shift beginning mid-second window involving all axes, with complex morphology suggesting superposed permanent and temporary components. Other segments show noise or smooth trends without clear morphological anomalies.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample abrupt drop in N (from ~0.3 to -2.5) around index 387–389, followed by a sustained offset and noisy recovery; E and U show correlated but less sharp changes, suggesting possible platform or opposing return not fully resolved at this scale.

Strong coherent motion in all axes from ~index 510 onward: N drops sharply (~-1.8 to -5.9), E rises then falls (~3.4 to -6.0), U fluctuates widely; the transition appears multi-sample and possibly includes superposed temporary offsets before settling into a new regime around index 540–550.
